Forward Deployment Engineer (Generative AI)
with Gen AI experience to join our fast-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are looking for top-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world.
Role Overview
The
Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE)
drives the on-site deployment, integration, and scaling of our enterprise Generative AI solutions. This role embeds directly within customer engineering teams to operationalize Large Language Models (LLMs) and retrieval systems across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). You will bridge the gap between AI research and production-grade cloud infrastructure.
You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and business partners and will have the opportunity to drive current and future strategy by leveraging your analytical skills as you ensure business value and communicate the results.
Requirements
Agentic Design & Implementation
Develop intelligent agents using Vertex AI Agent Builder to automate complex
business workflows.
Leverage the Agent Developer Kit (ADK) to build and manage multi-agent systems
that collaborate to solve end-to-end business challenges.
Implement tools like MCP (Model Context Protocol) Toolbox to securely connect
agents to enterprise databases like BigQuery and Spanner.
AI on Data Strategy
Utilize Vertex AI for model training, tuning, and deployment, ensuring seamless
integration with BigQuery for feature engineering.
Build and optimize streaming data pipelines (e.g., via Dataflow) to execute
real-time inference using RunInference API or Vertex AI endpoints.
Ground AI models in live business context using vector engines within BigQuery or
AlloyDB to eliminate "AI amnesia".
Operational Excellence (Soft Skills)
Active Participation: Show up promptly for all internal and client-facing meetings
Transparent Communication: Provide regular, structured status updates to team
members and stakeholders regarding project milestones and technical blockers.
Proactive Collaboration: Demonstrate the ability to ask for help when facing
technical hurdles and contribute to a collaborative troubleshooting environment.
Consultative Approach: Navigate corporate environments to translate high-level
business goals into robust technical architectures.
Technical Qualifications
Vertex AI Mastery: Proven experience with Model Garden, Vertex AI Pipelines, and
model evaluation.
Data Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of SQL for BigQuery, Python for ML
engineering, and data preprocessing techniques (scaling, encoding, imputation).
Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Storage and Vertex
AI endpoints.
Emerging Tech: Familiarity with stateful real-time processing and the latest
innovations in agentic architectures.
Benefits
This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous collaboration.

We're looking for a Lead AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered experiences, platforms, and intelligent workflows. This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who loves solving hard problems, building production-grade systems, and turning emerging AI capabilities into real business outcomes.
You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, AI, product development, and platform architecture—helping teams move from "what if?" to production. One week you might be designing agentic workflows, another optimizing large-scale retrieval systems, integrating AI into enterprise platforms, or evaluating the latest advances in foundation models.
If you're energized by new technology but grounded enough to know that reliability, security, scalability, and business value matter, we'd love to talk.
What You'll Do
Build AI That Actually Gets Used
Design and deliver AI-powered capabilities that solve meaningful business problems.
Develop solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), autonomous agents, semantic search, and other modern AI techniques.
Own technical architecture from prototype through production deployment.
Create reusable platform capabilities that accelerate future AI development.
Lead Through Engineering Excellence
Serve as a technical leader and trusted advisor across multiple teams.
Mentor engineers and help raise the overall technical bar.
Drive engineering best practices around architecture, testing, deployment, observability, and operational excellence.
Conduct design and code reviews while helping teams navigate complex technical decisions.
Explore What's Next
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and approaches.
Rapidly prototype new ideas and determine where they can create real value.
Bring a practical mindset to innovation—separating hype from opportunity.
Help define the organization's long-term AI engineering strategy.
Build for Scale
Design cloud-native systems capable of supporting enterprise-scale usage.
Optimize performance, reliability, scalability, and operational costs.
Develop integration patterns connecting AI capabilities to enterprise systems, knowledge sources, APIs, and workflows.
Help establish standards and foundations that enable many teams to build on top of AI safely and efficiently.
Champion Responsible AI
Ensure solutions meet security, privacy, compliance, and governance requirements.
Define evaluation strategies that measure quality, accuracy, safety, and business impact.
Help establish best practices for AI observability, monitoring, and risk management.
Use Your Skills To Make An Impact
What We're Looking For
Required
8+ years of software engineering experience.
3+ years building or leading production AI/ML solutions.
Strong experience with large language models, AI orchestration frameworks, vector search, RAG, and prompt engineering.
Proficiency in Python and at least one additional modern programming language, preferrably C#/.Net
Experience building cloud-native applications in Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, system design, APIs, CI/CD, testing, and DevSecOps.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives and influence across teams.
Nice to Have
Experience building agentic or autonomous AI systems.
Experience developing reusable AI platforms and shared services.
Familiarity with model evaluation frameworks, fine-tuning, or advanced ML techniques.
Experience building developer productivity or AI-assisted engineering solutions.
Experience operating in regulated or highly governed environments.
Open-source contributions, patents, technical publications, or conference speaking experience.
You'll Be Successful Here If You...
Get excited about building things that don't exist yet.
Can move comfortably between architecture diagrams, source code, and executive conversations.
Know when to innovate and when to simplify.
Enjoy mentoring other engineers and helping teams succeed.
Care as much about outcomes as you do technology.
Have a healthy skepticism of buzzwords and a passion for delivering real value.

You'll have the opportunity to influence the direction of AI across an entire enterprise, work with cutting-edge technologies, solve genuinely difficult technical challenges, and help define how AI capabilities are built, governed, and scaled for years to come.
